subject: Vendr portal onboarding + SIG/CAIQ evidence reconciliation
messages:
From: Ethan Moore <ethan@pinewavehealth.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Vendr access & SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Hi Jasmine,

Quick note — our procurement/security team needs Redwood added to our Vendr portal so we can collect the SIG/CAIQ and the supporting evidence bundle. Our onboarding checklist calls for: the latest SOC 2 attestation, KMS rotation proof, S3 evidence manifest for artifact possession, and a short description of your API network egress controls.

Can you confirm who will be the profile owner on your side and whether you can upload the evidence into Vendr by next Wednesday (26 May)? Happy to share a portal invite if you prefer.

Thanks,
Ethan Moore
Security Operations Lead
Pinewave Health

--
P.S. We typically request a single ZIP with filenames and a CSV manifest — let me know if that format works.

From: jasmine_liu <jasmine@redwoodinference.com>
To: Ethan Moore <ethan@pinewavehealth.com>
Cc: Vendr Portal Support <support@vendr.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Vendr access & SIG/CAIQ evidence request

Ethan — thanks for the clear list. I can be the profile owner for Redwood on Vendr and will coordinate the upload. A couple of clarifying items before we submit: 

- SOC 2: we can provide our most recent SOC 2 Type II report (PDF) and a short attestation note.
- KMS rotation: you mentioned a log excerpt — we have a rotation schedule and the last rotation audit. Is a signed snippet + rotation timestamp acceptable?
- S3 manifest: we will produce a CSV that lists artifact names + checksums and the S3 URIs.
- API egress controls: we will include a one-pager describing our IP egress, region routing policies, and egress-detection alerts.

Marissa (cc) — please prepare the SOC 2 PDF and the attestation note. Ben — can you pull the KMS rotation excerpt and S3 manifest? Karthik — I may need a 1-paragraph summary of routing/egress controls for the one-pager.

Ethan — uploading to Vendr works for us; please send the invite link when you’re ready. Targeting upload by Tue 25 May to give you time to review.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Security Program Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments referenced: none in this message.
